citation: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
country_context: United Kingdom (UK-based online retailer; ~91% of rows United Kingdom)
business_domain: Online retail / e-commerce, giftware and homeware
unsupported_tasks: digital_twin_wiring (benchmark only; never becomes an active SME model)
known_limitations: UK online retailer only - not representative of Indian SMEs or of retail generally.
No marketing-spend or promotion field; the forecasting adapter holds marketing_spend and promotion_flag at 0 (not invented).
Churn is a DERIVED label from purchase inactivity, not a ground-truth churn flag (see metadata.md).
Heavy right-skew: a handful of wholesale-style customers dominate revenue.
Returns/cancellations and non-product stock codes (POSTAGE, MANUAL, etc.) are filtered by the adapter.
MAPE is inflated: many product-days have near-zero units, making percentage error unstable. Treat MAE/RMSE as the primary forecasting metrics.
